sections.heading: PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
sections.text: Software engineer with a focus on software architecture and applied AI. Since 2019 I have built and maintained PHP/Laravel and TypeScript web applications, from greenfield architecture through CI/CD to test automation. Over the last two years I have integrated LLMs into real development workflows: designing AI agents, engineering prompts, and optimizing token usage and cost, using the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs and MCP. I like to understand a system end-to-end, measure the results, and keep improving it. Currently deepening Python for AI work and learning RAG and vector databases.

items.title: AI-Assisted Web Development
bullets: Designed and implemented the software architecture for a greenfield restaurant point-of-sale (POS) system: Laravel and PostgreSQL in the backend, Alpine.js with TypeScript in the frontend.
Integrated AI tools into daily development for code analysis, architectural design, code generation, and automation.
Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines in GitLab and containerized the application with Docker.
Automated tests with Codeception and PHPUnit using a behavior-driven (BDD) approach.
Specified features with Gherkin together with executive management and the Product Owner.

items.title: AI-Assisted Web Development
bullets: Independently planned, built, and maintained web applications, including ticketing systems, websites, and marketing tools.
Used AI tools productively for code analysis, architectural design, code generation, and automation.
Conceived requirements-appropriate custom software and designed the underlying database systems.
Automated tests with PHPUnit and documented code with PHPDoc; coordinated projects and communicated directly with clients.

items.title: AI Engineering Experiments
bullets: Built and evaluated AI workflows, agents, and integrations to move from prompt experiments toward practical, production-oriented use of LLMs.
Designed agent workflows and orchestrated multi-step tasks with the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs and MCP.
Optimized prompts and token usage, weighing cost against output quality.
Compared model strengths and weaknesses to choose the right model per task.

items.title: Trading Research & Backtesting Platform
bullets: Designed a Python research environment to evaluate large trading-strategy parameter spaces fast enough to iterate on ideas.
Processed tens to hundreds of millions of parameter combinations by replacing brute-force loops with vectorization and JIT compilation (NumPy, Numba).
Built reproducible backtesting workflows and modular scoring to compare strategies statistically instead of by intuition.

items.title: Laravel Pivot Events (Open Source)
bullets: Published a Laravel package that adds pivot (many-to-many) model events with custom IDs.

items.degree: IT Specialist for Application Development (Fachinformatikerin Anwendungsentwicklung)
